svg.text: Foot plate 75 x 25 x 6 with two 9 mm holes 50 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post 294 tall welded upright on the foot plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm 175 welded to the post top, pointing to the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring: 6 mm plate, 176 inside, 216 outside, welded flat on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arm end; its inside edge is the cone's size 40 above its bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the foot bolts on the front top rail at the bowl centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (two M8). The ring centre must sit over the spindle centre:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check with a plumb line from the ring to the spindle top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lift off with two bolts for transport.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: ring level; hopper sits in it without rocking.
